title: Battle of Haldighati
summary: In 1576 a Mughal army led by Raja Man Singh of Amber, sent by Akbar, fought Rana Pratap Singh of Mewar at the Haldighati pass in the Aravalli hills. Encyclopedia.com records a Mughal victory in which Pratap escaped because a Jhala chief took his place under the royal insignia; Pratap then turned to guerrilla tactics.

as_recorded.value: defeated the Rana and his allies at Haldighati Pass in 1576
the Battle of Haldighati was fought in 1576

where.modern_name: Haldighati pass, Aravalli Range, Rajasthan, India

importance.justification: A battle between the Mughal empire and Mewar in 1576 after which Encyclopedia.com says Pratap Singh abandoned direct battle for guerrilla tactics.

sources.title: Haldighati: Renowned Arena of a Famous Battle
sources.publisher: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan

reviewer_note: Least sure of the outcome: Encyclopedia.com calls it a defeat for the Rana; the Rajasthan tourism page gives no result and says only that Pratap fought bravely. Other accounts of the result are disputed and were not opened. Day and month are not on the opened pages, so only the year is recorded. Pin is the pass (Wikidata), about 40 km from Udaipur per Rajasthan Tourism.
